sentences.text: On June 23, 2026 Tokyo Electron appointed long-serving executive Hiroshi Ishida as Senior Executive Vice President and Representative Director, with the Chief Operating Officer role from July 2026, while Sadao Sasaki and outside director Sachiko Ichikawa retired and Shinichi Hayashi and Jennifer Rogers joined the board.

sentences.quote: Under the leadership of CEO Toshiki Kawai and COO Hiroyuki Ishida, Hiroshi Kawamoto will assume the role of CFO. Nine executive officers including Sadao Sasaki will step down.
sentences.text: From July 1, 2026 a CFO post was created within the Finance Division and filled by Hiroshi Kawamoto, with nine executive officers including Sasaki stepping down.

Kawai has set a goal of gross margin above 50% within two years, via price increases, productivity and new models, toward the mid-term plan's 35% operating margin, with the WFE market seen at $150 billion or more in 2026.
